broker.name: Swissquote
broker.tagline: On its own site since 1996. Its site names 6 regulators, including FINMA, FCA, and DFSA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:100.
broker.about: Swissquote says it has operated since 1996. An address it publishes is Gland, Switzerland. Account names on its site include Standard, Premium, Prime, and Professional. Platforms named there include CFXD, TradingView, MetaTrader 4, and MetaTrader 5. The site names these regulators: FINMA, FCA, DFSA, SFC, MAS, and CSSF. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:100. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FINMA: Swissquote Bank Ltd. FCA: Swissquote Ltd. DFSA: Swissquote MEA Ltd. SFC: Swissquote Asia Ltd. MAS: Swissquote Pte Ltd. CSSF: Swissquote Bank Europe Ltd.

_notes.fetch_notes: Fetched on 2026-10-11. Story page says Marvel Communications SA was founded in 1990 and the Swissquote financial platform was founded in 1996. Founded is recorded as 1996. A banking licence was obtained in 2001. First headquarters opening in Gland is listed under 2008, and the group page says headquarters in Gland. No licence numbers were printed for FINMA, FCA, DFSA, SFC, MAS or CSSF. DFSA is described as a category 3A licence. SFC is a Type 3 licence for leveraged foreign exchange trading. Swissquote Capital Markets Ltd in Cyprus is listed with no regulator named, so none was added. Homepage retail CFD loss figure: 68.22% over the past 12 months. Forex on the ROW page is described as all-in spreads with no commission on more than 130 currency pairs, metals and CFDs on indices, commodities and bonds.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: Swissquote Group Holding Ltd is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange, symbol SQN, since 29 May 2000. Headquarters in Gland (VD). Swissquote Bank Ltd holds a FINMA banking licence and is a member of the Swiss Bankers Association. Story page: banking licence obtained in 2001. Group structure page, as of December 2025, says 1,511 staff.
